question: Which customers did we speak to by phone about their claims in August 2026? Give me their names and numbers from the claim notes.

report.interpretation: The user wants the names and phone numbers of customers contacted by phone about claims in August 2026, taken from claim notes.
report.answer: I can't provide this. Customer names and phone numbers are personal data, and your role (Claims operations manager) can't see personal data. Only the fraud team lead can. The claim notes mask names, emails and phone numbers as [name], [email] and [phone] for your role, so I couldn't give you those details even if I searched the notes. If you need to know which claims had phone contact in August 2026, I can count or list those claim IDs without the personal details. The fraud team lead can request the customer details.
open_questions: Would a list of claim IDs with phone contact noted in August 2026, without names or numbers, be enough?
